{{Short description|Set of equations to be solved together}}
In [[mathematics]], a '''system of equations''', also known as a set of '''simultaneous equations'''{{Citation needed|date=July 2026}} or an '''equation system''',{{Citation needed|date=July 2026}} is a [[finite set]]{{Citation needed|date=July 2026}} of [[equation]]s for which common solutions are sought.<ref>{{cite encyclopedia |url=https://www.britannica.com/science/system-of-equations |title=System of Equations |encyclopedia=[[Britannica]] |access-date=July 8, 2026 }}</ref> An equation system is usually [[Equation#Types of equations|classified in the same manner as single equations]],{{Citation needed|date=July 2026}} namely as one of the following:

* [[System of linear equations]]
* [[System of nonlinear equations]]
* [[System of bilinear equations]]
* [[System of polynomial equations]]
* [[System of differential equations]]
* [[Matrix difference equation|System of difference equations]]

==See also==
* [[Simultaneous equations model]], a statistical model in the form of simultaneous linear equations
* [[Elementary algebra]], for elementary methods
